39: def reflectedMetric (F : Tensor4) (c : Coordinate4) : Tensor4 :=

42: def reflectedInverse (F : Tensor4) (c : Coordinate4) : Tensor4 :=

243: structure SelectedProbabilityData (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (U : Set Coordinate4) where
244:   probabilities : Coordinate4 → ι → ℝ
245:   normalized : ∀ x, ∑ i, probabilities x i=1
246:   positive : ∀ x∈U, ∀ i, 0<probabilities x i
247:   smooth : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => probabilities x i) U
248:   differential_injective : ∀ x∈U, Function.Injective (directionalVariation probabilities x)
249:   selected : ι
250:   clock_nonzero : ∀ x∈U, probabilityDifferential probabilities x selected≠0
251: 
252: variable {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {U : Set Coordinate4}
253: 
254: def selectedFisher (P : SelectedProbabilityData ι U) : TensorField4 :=
255:   fisherTensorField P.probabilities
256: 
257: def selectedClock (P : SelectedProbabilityData ι U) : CovectorField4 :=
258:   fun x => probabilityDifferential P.probabilities x P.selected
259: 
260: def selectedMetric (P : SelectedProbabilityData ι U) : TensorField4 :=
261:   fun x => reflectedMetric (selectedFisher P x) (selectedClock P x)

44: def conditionalProbability (P : SelectedProbabilityData (Option J) U) (j : J) (x : Coordinate4) : ℝ :=

47: def sigmaPotential (P : SelectedProbabilityData (Option J) U) (j : J) (x : Coordinate4) : ℝ :=
48:   Real.sqrt (conditionalProbability P j x)

50: def sigmaCovectors (P : SelectedProbabilityData (Option J) U) : J → CovectorField4 :=
51:   potentialFamily (sigmaPotential P)

41: /-- The source covectors are derivatives of the same input probability observations. -/
42: def probabilityCovectors (P : SelectedProbabilityData ι U) : ι → CovectorField4 :=
43:   fun i => potentialCovector (fun x => P.probabilities x i)
44: 
45: theorem probability_covectors_smooth (P : SelectedProbabilityData ι U) (hU : IsOpen U)
46:     (i : ι) : SmoothVectorOn U (probabilityCovectors P i) :=
47:   potential_covector_smooth U hU _ (P.smooth i)
48: 
49: theorem probability_covectors_closed (P : SelectedProbabilityData ι U) (hU : IsOpen U)
50:     (i : ι) : ClosedCovectorOn U (probabilityCovectors P i) :=
51:   potential_covector_closed U hU _ (P.smooth i)

41: def fisherTensorAt (p : ι → ℝ) (dp : ι → Coordinate4) : Tensor4 :=
42:   ∑ i, (p i)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec (dp i) (dp i)

44: /-- Actual coordinate differential of the probability field. -/
45: def probabilityDifferential (P : Coordinate4 → ι → ℝ) (x : Coordinate4) (i : ι) : Coordinate4 :=
46:   potentialCovector (fun y => P y i) x
47: 
48: def directionalVariation (P : Coordinate4 → ι → ℝ) (x v : Coordinate4) : ι → ℝ :=
49:   fun i => covectorRead (probabilityDifferential P x i) v
50: 
51: def fisherTensorField (P : Coordinate4 → ι → ℝ) : TensorField4 :=
52:   fun x => fisherTensorAt (P x) (probabilityDifferential P x)
53: 
54: theorem fisher_tensor_entries (p : ι → ℝ) (dp : ι → Coordinate4) (a b : Fin 4) :
55:     fisherTensorAt p dp a b = ∑ i, dp i a * dp i b / p i := by
56:   simp only [fisherTensorAt, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec,
57:     Matrix.of_apply, smul_eq_mul]
58:   apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
59:   intro i _
60:   ring

27: def connectionCurvatureJet (Gamma : ConnectionMatrix4) (dGamma : ConnectionDerivative4)
28:     (i j : Fin 4) : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ :=
29:   dGamma i j-dGamma j i+Gamma i*Gamma j-Gamma j*Gamma i

28:   ∀ i, SmoothMatrixOn U (fun x => Gamma x i)

30: def connectionFirstJet (Gamma : ConnectionField4) (x : Coordinate4) : ConnectionDerivative4 :=
31:   fun i j => tensorFieldJet (fun y => Gamma y j) x i
32: 
33: def connectionSecondJet (Gamma : ConnectionField4) (x : Coordinate4) : ConnectionSecondDerivative4 :=
34:   fun k i j => tensorFieldJet (fun y => connectionFirstJet Gamma y i j) x k
35: 
36: def coordinateCurvature (Gamma : ConnectionField4) (x : Coordinate4) (i j : Fin 4) :
37:     Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ := connectionCurvatureJet (Gamma x) (connectionFirstJet Gamma x) i j

31: def coordinateRicci (Gamma : ConnectionField4) (x : Coordinate4) : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ :=
32:   fun b j => ∑ a, coordinateCurvature Gamma x a j a b
33: 
34: def coordinateScalarCurvature (gInv : TensorField4) (Gamma : ConnectionField4) (x : Coordinate4) : ℝ :=
35:   ∑ i, ∑ j, gInv x i j*coordinateRicci Gamma x i j
36: 
37: def geometricEinsteinTensor (g gInv : TensorField4) (Gamma : ConnectionField4) (x : Coordinate4) :
38:     Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ :=
39:   coordinateRicci Gamma x-(coordinateScalarCurvature gInv Gamma x/2) • g x

17:   pesos de Gibbs `pᵢ = e^{−hᵢ}/Z`, a derivada da ENERGIA LIVRE
18:   `F(ε) = S(p+εq) − ⟨h⟩_{p+εq}` é ZERO em ε = 0 para TODA perturbação de
19:   traço zero — o habitante é caracterizado pelo MOVIMENTO (a variação),
20:   não pelo léxico (composição da primeira lei v51 com o termo linear);
21: * ★ **E SÓ O GIBBS** (`critical_iff_gibbs`): se a variação de F anula
22:   para TODA direção de traço zero, então `log pᵢ + hᵢ` é CONSTANTE — os
23:   pesos são Gibbs. Criticalidade ⟺ KMS, com UNICIDADE (a face finita da
24:   ergodicidade que a Pergunta Id pedia);

20: structure ActionCouplingData (X : Type*) where
21:   boxOperator : (X → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℂ)
22:   mass : ℝ
23:   xi : ℝ
24:   scalarCurvature : X → ℝ
25:   K_boundary : (X → ℂ) →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℂ)
26: 
27: namespace ActionCouplingData
28: noncomputable section
29: variable {X : Type*}
30: 
31: def curvatureTerm (D : ActionCouplingData X) (psi : X → ℂ) : X → ℂ :=
32:   fun x => D.scalarCurvature x • psi x
33: 
34: def fieldOperator (D : ActionCouplingData X) (psi : X → ℂ) : X → ℂ :=
35:   D.boxOperator psi - D.mass ^ 2 • psi - D.xi • D.curvatureTerm psi
36: 
37: def modularSource (D : ActionCouplingData X) (c : TGLCoupling)
38:     (psi : X → ℂ) : X → ℂ := c.beta • D.K_boundary psi
39: 
40: /-- INPUT: the field equation; the data structure alone does not supply it. -/
41: def EOM (D : ActionCouplingData X) (c : TGLCoupling) (psi : X → ℂ) : Prop :=
42:   D.fieldOperator psi = D.modularSource c psi

42: /-- Same data shape and nonzero source, but a different box gain refutes EOM. -/
43: theorem scalar_model_rejects_wrong_gain (c : TGLCoupling) (xi gain : ℝ)
44:     (hg : gain ≠ c.beta) : ¬ (scalarModel xi gain).EOM c unitSection := by
45:   intro h
46:   have heq : gain • unitSection = c.beta • unitSection :=
47:     (scalar_model_field xi gain).symm.trans h
48:   exact hg (smul_left_injective ℝ unitSection_ne_zero heq)
49: 
50: /-- In particular the three readings and the operator data do not supply EOM. -/
51: theorem data_alone_does_not_supply_eom (c : TGLCoupling) (xi : ℝ) :
52:     ¬ (scalarModel xi (-c.beta)).EOM c unitSection := by
53:   apply scalar_model_rejects_wrong_gain
54:   linarith [c.beta_pos]
